text.title: Business Model Research Examples
text.summary: End-to-end worked example illustrating the methodology against a realistic input.

example.title: Sub-1000-subscriber email tool
example.note: Founder pitches an email-marketing SaaS for solo creators. Step 1: value chain - content creators - ESP infra (SES) - subscribers; key cost driver is per-send infra + deliverability monitoring. Step 2: archetypes - pick subscription + one-time founding-creator lifetime deal; reject transaction, advertising, marketplace commission with one-liners. Step 3: comparables - ConvertKit, Beehiiv, Substack pricing pages pulled 2026-05-12, tagged Hard with URLs. Step 4: Canvas filled; gross margin sourced from Beehiiv deck = 62% (Hard). Step 5: P10 ARPU $9, churn 6%/mo, CAC $40 -> LTV <=60mo = $90, LTV:CAC = 2.3:1, payback 7mo. P50 ARPU $19, churn 3%, CAC $25 -> LTV $390, LTV:CAC 15.6:1. Step 6: stress tests - Scale ok, Competition ok, Churn (2x) marginal at P10 (LTV:CAC 1.1:1), CAC inflation flagged, Time-to-profit at P50 18mo. Verdict: viable-with-fixes; flag CAC channel concentration; require quarterly re-run.

example.title: P10/P50/P90 bands
example.note: P10: ARPU $20, churn 6%, CAC $80 → LTV $280, LTV:CAC 3.5:1, payback 20mo. P50: ARPU $29, churn 3%, CAC $50 → LTV $773, LTV:CAC 15:1, payback 9mo. P90: ARPU $38, churn 2%, CAC $35 → LTV $1267, LTV:CAC 36:1, payback 5mo. Verdict based on P10: model survives at minimum threshold.

example.title: Build prompt
example.note: Build prompt — step sequence enforced, Hard/Soft tagging required:
example.code: You are a business-model analyst. Build a Business Model Canvas + unit economics for: <product idea>. Constraints: <ICP, geo, stage>. Steps: (1) map value chain, (2) shortlist 2 of 5 revenue archetypes, (3) pull 3 public comparables per archetype, (4) fill Canvas with H/S tags per cell, (5) compute CAC/LTV/payback in P10/P50/P90, (6) run all 5 stress tests, (7) emit verdict. Refuse to average ranges. Cite source URL + retrieval date for every Hard cell. Output: markdown matching business-model-canvas.md sections.

example.title: Validate prompt
example.note: Validate prompt — returns delta list, not a rewrite:
example.code: Validate this business model: <paste canvas + unit economics>. Check: (1) is gross margin sourced or assumed? (2) does churn vary by cohort age? (3) does LTV:CAC survive at P10? (4) are revenue streams additive or substitutive? (5) is payback < 12 months at P50? Return delta list, not rewrite.
